title: One-per-page post meta both sites added under crossed meta ids merges as one row
steps: Run the WordPress merge case: copy template under meta_id 24, live template under 25 and another live row under 24.
expect: The page has one _wp_page_template row (the copy value) and a conflict; the same _thumbnail_id is one row; the live row of its own comes over.

tests: one-per-page meta both sites added under crossed meta_ids still meets as one row
